subtitle: Lesson 40 · Python for Data Engineers

eyebrow: A validation function and its first test
caption: pytest discovers tests by filename (test_*.py) and function name (test_*) automatically — no registration step.
A function only ever tested with good input can hide a bug in its failure path — the exact path a pipeline leans on to catch bad data.

eyebrow: pytest.raises() for functions that should error
caption: pytest.raises() asserts a block of code raises a specific exception — the test fails if the ValueError doesn't happen.

code:
pytest test_validators.py -v

# test_validators.py::test_validate_row_accepts_a_good_row PASSED
# test_validators.py::test_validate_row_rejects_missing_order_id PASSED
# test_validators.py::test_validate_row_rejects_zero_amount PASSED
# test_validators.py::test_parse_amount_raises_on_none PASSED
# test_validators.py::test_parse_amount_converts_a_string PASSED
caption: -v prints one line per test instead of just a dot — useful while you're actively writing tests.

subtitle: Catching the right exceptions, retrying flaky calls, and failing loud on purpose.
